The manor

No one leaves until the case is solved. Each guest is being held in a different room. Visit the rooms in any order: read the guest’s ideas, answer three questions, then decode a witness clue. Each witness describes a different guest.

The case and witnesses are invented. The thinkers and their ideas are real.
